class.name: SteamScope
class.brief_description: Steam capabilities captured by one attached GameRuntime, with diagnostics for startup failures.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Return whether this attachment has a live Steam client and provider.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Return the confirmed active Steam AppID, or zero when unavailable.

method.name: get_local_steam_id
method.description: Return the local signed-in SteamID64, or an empty string when unavailable.

method.name: get_initialization_error
method.description: Return the diagnostic captured by this game's provider. Successful attachments return an empty string.

method.name: lobbies
method.description: Resolve this exact attachment's lobby discovery service. Retained services expire on tree exit.

method.name: apps
method.description: Read app metadata through this attachment's active Steam client. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: friends
method.description: Use this attachment's active friends service. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: overlay
method.description: Use this attachment's overlay actions and state when Steam provides them. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: utils
method.description: Read client and hardware state through this attachment. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: diagnostics
method.description: Resolve the warning capture service for this attachment. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: http
method.description: Issue HTTP requests on this attachment's client scope. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: stats
method.description: Read or manage this attachment's Steam stats and achievements. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: leaderboards
method.description: Resolve the leaderboard service for this attachment. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: cloud
method.description: Resolve Steam Cloud for this attachment. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: timeline
method.description: Resolve Steam Game Recording events for this attachment. Returns null when this generation has ended.

method.name: screenshots
method.description: Returns the screenshot capture and result service for this exact Game attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.

method.name: remote_play
method.description: Returns the Remote Play session and input service for this exact Game attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.

method.name: inventory
method.description: Returns the Steam Inventory service for this exact Game attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.

method.name: workshop
method.description: Returns the Steam Workshop service for this exact Game attachment. Returns null after the attachment ends.

method.name: presence
method.description: Returns the managed Rich Presence service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: music
method.description: Returns the Steam music player service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: video
method.description: Returns the Steam video and broadcast service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: device
method.description: Returns the device, virtual keyboard, and VR status service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: auth
method.description: Returns the authentication and ownership ticket service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: input
method.description: Returns the Steam Input controller service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: browser
method.description: Returns the Steam HTML Surface service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: purchases
method.description: Returns the purchase facade for this exact Game attachment, or null after it ends. Bind a backend through [method SteamProvider.with_commerce_backend].

method.name: voice
method.description: Returns Steam voice capture and decoding for this exact Game attachment, or null after the attachment ends.

method.name: parties
method.description: Returns this attachment's Steam Parties service, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: server_browser
method.description: Return this exact client scope's Steam dedicated server browser, or null when its client is unavailable.

method.name: messages
method.description: Returns this attachment's Steam message service for admitted peers and configured channels. Returns null after the attachment ends.

method.name: networking
method.description: Returns the Steam relay and connection-path diagnostics for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.

method.name: sockets
method.description: Returns the standalone Steam Sockets service for this exact Game attachment, or null after the scope ends.
